phase_name: Characterize and Guarantee cycle_modified_files Accumulation Across a Refused Postflight

objectives.description: Write characterization case driving exit-6 refusal, assert cycle_modified_files non-empty
Run against unmodified code, record result (GREEN: already ungated)
Green path: add deploy_pending assertion instead of a redundant fix
Add guard comment at accumulation block naming the regression anchor

phase_notes: Characterization result: GREEN against unmodified code. The WORK (j) cycle_modified_files accumulation block (orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh ~1169-1176) is gated ONLY by [ -z "$loop_guard_file" ] and is_live -- confirmed by direct grep at lines 1140-1141 and by the new characterization test, which drives a REAL exit-6 refusal via a stale-extension fixture (build_deploy_stale_fixture, modelled on test-postflight-deploy-gate.sh's Case 1) and confirms cycle_modified_files accumulates despite the refusal. No script fix was needed for Part 2's literal framing; the static reading (research finding #3) was correct and the dispatch's 'refusal aborts before accumulation' hypothesis was WRONG. Added: (a) the characterization test with a regression-anchor self-check (temporarily re-gating the block flips the case red, proving it is live, not vacuous), (b) a deploy_pending marker assertion on .return-meta.json (the durable cross-invocation signal Phase 3's checkpoint widening consumes), (c) a guard comment on the accumulation block naming this test as its regression anchor. Full suite: 104 passed, 0 failed.
